blocks.title: Smart contract
blocks.text: A smart contract is a digital agreement on a blockchain that automatically carries out its terms when specific conditions are met, removing intermediaries and reducing errors and fraud.

Platforms such as Ethereum let developers build decentralized applications (DApps) with smart contracts for finance, supply chains, real estate and insurance. A flight-insurance contract can pay out automatically if a flight is delayed. Smart contracts are transparent and their execution is guaranteed by the blockchain, but they need error-free code and legal systems to settle disputes.
